assertions.title: Waitlist settings screen saves and gates the feature
steps: Opened /acme/reservations/settings/waitlist as kody; screen showed enabled/online/notify-me on, response 10, party limit empty.

Network: GET http://localhost:3007/operator/reservations/setup/locations/v17plv08r5v357bie335lyq8/waitlist -> 200 with version 33, waitlistEnabled true, waitlistOnline true, notifyMeEnabled true, waitlistResponseMin 10, waitlistMaxParties null (same values as the screen and the DB row).

Toggled all three switches off, set response 12 and party limit 6, saved: PUT .../waitlist -> 200, body {expectedVersion:33, waitlistEnabled:false, waitlistOnline:false, notifyMeEnabled:false, waitlistResponseMin:12, waitlistMaxParties:6}; success banner 'Waitlist settings saved.'; DB version 34.
Reloaded the screen: the three switches render unchecked, response 12, party limit 6; the re-fetched GET returns the same values (version 34).

Restored the baseline (all three on, response 10, party limit empty): PUT -> 200, DB version 35; final restore after the deadline branch left version 40 with the same baseline values, confirmed on the screen after reload and in sqlite.

Feature gating through the token features claim: a book token minted with features.waitlist=false gets 404 'Not found' from all eight route forms (GET /book/waitlist/, GET /book/waitlist/quote, POST /book/waitlist/, POST /book/waitlist/reorder, PATCH /book/waitlist/:id, POST /book/waitlist/:id/notify, POST /book/waitlist/:id/status, POST /book/waitlist/:id/seat); the control request with waitlist=true returns 200 with the listing.
assertions.limitations: The 'App waitlist screens 404 when reservations.waitlist is off' half was NOT exercised live: org flag toggles are serial and owned by g12-flags this round, and my assignment forbids changing org flags. The tenant-api half (token features claim -> 404 on every waitlist route) was verified directly with a minted token. Settings-permission gating was only exercised as an admin (kody); no negative-permission case.
assertions.notes: No 409s occurred on any settings write; the location settings version moved 33 -> 40 across the session, including +3 while I was not writing, so other validators also change waitlist settings concurrently. I re-read the live value before each write and used the live expectedVersion.

assertions.title: Operator adds a walk-in party with a simulated quote
steps: App waitlist screen -> 'Add party' dialog; filled name 'B3 Walkin One', size 3, phone +1555555231 with the SMS opt-in checked, notes; the dialog showed 'Quote this party 1 min. They would be number 3 in line.'
Network: GET /operator/reservations/book/waitlist/quote?locationId=...&partySize=3 -> 200 {quotedMin:1, quotedWaitMin:1, quotedReadyAt:1792235750541, position:3}.

Submit: POST /operator/reservations/book/waitlist -> 201 with entry wle_1f765ab1-6b34-455d-a417-126db7eeabed, status 'waiting', quotedMin 1, quotedReadyAt set (same party size as the quote -> consistent).
The queue card appeared immediately as '#3 B3 Walkin One (3) ... Quoted 1 min' and the summary went to 'In line: 3'.

Poll check on Today: with the Today screen open (no reload) a second walk-in (B3 Walkin Two, +1555555232) added via the API at 11:15:24 appeared as a new row in the Today waitlist card by 11:15:32 (one 5 s poll), quoted wait shown ('Quoted 1 min'); the card count went 3 -> 4.
assertions.limitations: The area-preference field was exercised only as the default 'Any area' (optional in the contract).
assertions.notes: Today renders the waitlist as a card with rows (today-waitlist-row-<id>), not as a literal tab; the card updated without a reload. Background tabs throttle the 5 s poll in headless Chrome, so the poll check was done with the Today tab active.

assertions.title: Notify the guest - message, status and response deadline
steps: Pressed Notify on the waiting walk-in with the opted-in US phone +1555555231: POST /operator/reservations/book/waitlist/wle_1f765ab1.../notify -> 200 {changed:true}.
Response/DB: status 'notified', notified_at 1792235745975, response_deadline_at 1792236345975 = notified_at + 600000 ms = waitlist_response_min (10).

Message: '[SMS MOCK] To: +1555555231 | Message: Downtown Flagship: your table is ready. http://localhost:3001/reserve/waitlist#t=<status-token>' - restaurant name and the entry's status link; rsv_messages has waitlist_ready/sms/sent for the entry. The operator card shows the 'Notified' badge and an 'Answer within 9:48' countdown.

Repeated Notify on the already notified entry (the UI correctly hides Notify for notified entries, so the repeat was sent through the API with the current version): 200 {changed:false}, version unchanged (2), notified_at/response_deadline_at unchanged, message count for the entry 2 -> 2 and SMS MOCK lines for the phone 2 -> 2 (no second message).
assertions.limitations: The entry had a phone but no email, so the SMS channel is the one that proves delivery here; the email channel is proven on the remote entries (see VAL-CROSS-016).
assertions.notes: The walk-in add also produced the expected waitlist_joined SMS because the phone was opted in.

POST /operator/reservations/book/waitlist/wle_0e2d1435.../seat -> 200: entry status 'seated' with reservationId rsv_fb9985c4-25d4-4a24-9825-e0826ea16602; the returned reservation has channel 'waitlist', status 'seated', tableIds [G10-T10].

assertions.title: Reorder the queue and the order persists
steps: Seven active entries were in the queue (2 seeded + 5 of mine); before the move the order was Julian #1, Fatima #2, B3 Remote One #3, B3 Walkin Cancel #4, B3 Walkin Drag #5, B3 Remote Two #6, B3 Remote Leave #7.

Pressed the move-up affordance on B3 Remote Two: POST /operator/reservations/book/waitlist/reorder -> 200 with ids [...Walkin Cancel, Remote Two, Walkin Drag, Remote Leave]; the list immediately showed Remote Two #5 and Walkin Drag #6.
Reloaded the page: the new order survived (Remote Two #5, Walkin Drag #6) - persisted sort_key 10 vs 11 in rsv_waitlist_entries (not local state).
The moved entry's guest status page (Sites, same tab, polled) now reports position 5 (was 6) with the quoted wait.
assertions.limitations: The move was one step up, so it swapped with the neighbouring entry (B3 Walkin Drag, mine); the two seeded entries kept their positions.
assertions.notes: The UI reorder sends the complete active order; the server only trades the listed slots.

assertions.title: Cancel, leave and edit from the operator side
steps: Cancel: 'Remove from list' on B3 Walkin Cancel showed the confirmation ('Remove B3 Walkin Cancel from the waitlist?'), 'Yes, remove' -> POST /status {status:'cancelled', expectedVersion:1} -> 200; the entry is 'cancelled' (version 2), moved to the settled list, and the active count dropped 'In line: 6' -> 'In line: 5'.
Edit: the Edit dialog on B3 Remote Two changed the party size to 4 and the notes -> PATCH /book/waitlist/wle_439e9f99... -> 200 with expectedVersion 2, DB version 2 -> 3.

Stale version: PATCH with expectedVersion 2 while the row was at version 3 -> 409 {"error":"stale_version","message":"Expected version 2, found 3"}; the retry with expectedVersion 3 -> 200 and version 4.

Guest leave: on the status page, 'Leave the waitlist' -> 'Yes, leave' -> POST /reservations/waitlist/status/leave -> 200, guest page 'You left the waitlist' (state left). The operator tab (no reload) still showed the entry as waiting at t+0s and showed the settled row 'B3 Remote Leave (2) | Left' at t+7s (one 5 s poll), with 'In line' 5 -> 4.

No messages after settle: POST /notify on the cancelled entry -> 409 invalid_status_transition ('Cannot move a waitlist entry from cancelled to notified'), messages 0 -> 0; on the left entry -> 409 ('...from left to notified'), messages 1 -> 1.
assertions.limitations: The 409 stale_version case was driven through the API (the UI cannot be made stale without racing another writer); the 200 edit case came from the UI.
assertions.notes: Cancelled/left entries render as settled rows with no actions except 'Back to waiting' for no_response.

assertions.title: Drag a waitlist card onto the floor plan seats the party
steps: Floor screen with the waitlist panel open; dispatched dragstart/dragenter/dragover/drop/dragend with a DataTransfer (CDP drag does not work on the canvas) carrying text/waitlist-id = wle_22e9180e... (B3 Walkin Drag, waiting) onto the free table G15-T1 (tbl_b2e8c3a2-ebfa-430c-8665-afa0ec4f023b).
Network: POST /operator/reservations/book/waitlist/wle_22e9180e.../seat {tableIds:[G15-T1], expectedVersion:2} -> 200; entry seated with reservationId rsv_3fb1efdd-a920-44bf-982e-9ddf1ca044d7.

sqlite: reservation channel 'waitlist', status 'seated'; rsv_table_occupancies active row on G15-T1; the table flipped to data-live-status='seated' with the timer '0m - 74m left' and the guest 'B3 D.'.

Dropping a second waiting card (B3 Remote Two) onto the now occupied G15-T1: POST /seat -> 409 table_occupied and the prompt 'Table G15-T1 is not free for this party / Booked by B3 Walkin Drag (2) - RGY9A3 / Choose how to seat B3 Remote Two (3) at table G15-T1' with the server-named resolutions 'Move the booking to a free table' and 'Overbook: seat anyway' (plus Cancel); cancelling left the entry waiting.
assertions.limitations: 'Swap' was not offered for this occupant because it was already seated; the shared resolution rule (rsv-waitlist-seat-resolution.ts availableResolutions) offers swap only when every occupant is a reservation that has not arrived, and move+overbook otherwise - the prompt showed exactly the server-named set. No drop onto a hold or a not-yet-arrived occupant was exercised.
assertions.notes: The keyboard/button equivalent ('Seat at G15-T1' after selecting the table) exists in the panel; the dispatched drag used the same code path.

assertions.title: Remote waitlist join triggers manager alert, ready notification, status page and seating from the floor
steps: 1. Guest join: Sites /reserve/waitlist, name 'B3 Remote One', phone +1555555236, email rsv-b3-6@example.com, party 3, SMS opt-in -> POST /reservations/waitlist/join -> 201 (entry wle_bcdffcc3-08ab-4e70-ae64-3a83b058ed02, status waiting, position 5, quotedMin 1); the status page showed POSITION IN LINE 5, ESTIMATED WAIT 'About 1 min', party 3, location Downtown Flagship. Messages: waitlist_joined SMS MOCK line and a captured email 'You are on the waitlist at Downtown Flagship' with the status link.

2. Manager alert: the tenant outbox row manager_alert dedupe_key waitlist_remote_join:wle_bcdffcc3-08ab-4e70-ae64-3a83b058ed02 (count 1, sent); App D1 Notification rows type reservations-waitlist-remote-join for kody (and 4 other admins) with payload {kind, locationId, count:1, orgSlug, locationName} only - no guest PII; the bell shows '1 guest joined the waitlist remotely / Open the waitlist to see who is waiting. / Location: Downtown Flagship'. The entry appears in the App waitlist screen.

3. Operator Notify: POST /book/waitlist/wle_bcdffcc3.../notify -> 200; captured email 'Your table at Downtown Flagship is ready' (kind waitlist_ready) with the status link; DB notified_at 1792236148573 / response_deadline_at 1792236748573 (10 min window); the guest status page switched to 'Your table is ready' with a hold countdown (9:46) and the 'I am on my way' action; the guest pressed it -> POST /reservations/waitlist/status/on-my-way -> 200, state on_the_way.

4. Seating across surfaces: kody dragged the on-the-way card from the floor waitlist panel onto the free table G10-T7 -> POST /seat -> 200, entry seated with reservation rsv_4087d11a-db68-414b-99fb-3c9819bb5516 (channel waitlist, status seated, party 3); the table flips to occupied with '0m - 90m left'; Today shows 'G10-T7 - B3 Remote One (3) | Waitlist | 0m / 90m'; the guest status page shows 'You have been seated / Enjoy your meal.'

5. Deadline branch: set the location response window to 1 minute (settings screen, PUT 200), notified the second remote entry (B3 Remote Two, +1555555234) -> response_deadline_at = notified_at + 60000 ms; the guest page showed the ready state with a 0:46 hold; after the deadline POST /api/reservations/tick -> 200 with the waitlist_offers task count 1, the entry became no_response; the guest page reports state no_response ('Your table was released') with position null, and the operator list shows the settled row 'B3 Remote Two (4) | No response' ('In line' dropped to 2). The response window was restored to 10 minutes afterwards.
assertions.limitations: Two wording deviations, both judged non-failing: (a) the waitlist_ready email contains the restaurant name and the status link but not a literal response-deadline text - the deadline is persisted on the entry (response_deadline_at) and shown as the hold countdown on the status page; (b) the status page reported position 5 rather than position 1 because the shared acme queue already held other parties (2 seeded + other validators' entries) - the position is the real queue position.
assertions.notes: All five steps were executed in this session on the live services; the deadline branch used the explicit tick POST after the 1-minute window (the Node interval tick had also already swept an earlier entry, confirming the sweep runs on its own).

frictions.description: The agent-browser session lost its cookies mid-run (the browser restarted: the tab fell back to about:blank and the App redirected to /login).
frictions.resolution: Logged in again, then relaunched the session with --restore so state autosaves; no further loss occurred.

frictions.description: In headless Chrome only the active tab runs timers, so the App's 5-second polls (Today card, operator waitlist, floor) do not advance while their tab is in the background; the Today waitlist card looked stale until the tab was activated.
frictions.resolution: Switched to the tab under test, waited one poll interval, then read the DOM without reloading.

frictions.description: Clicks on the settings switches are swallowed by the sidebar overlay (aside.bg-background) for agent-browser ref/selector clicks.
frictions.resolution: Used in-page element.click() and the native value setter plus input/change events for React-controlled inputs.

frictions.description: Guest status links in messages point at the App origin in local dev: because acme has no customDomain, reservations.context.ts:181 falls back to appUrl, so the SMS/email link is http://localhost:3001/reserve/waitlist#t=..., and that URL answers 404 on the App (while /reserve 302s to /login). The guest page itself works on the Sites host (http://acme.menuza.test:3008/reserve/waitlist).
frictions.resolution: Reported as an observation, not adjudicated: the messages do contain the restaurant name and a status link with the token (what VAL-WAIT-004 asks for), and the guest status page was exercised on the Sites host. Looks like a pre-existing siteOrigin fallback that also affects manage links.

frictions.description: Two one-off React hydration-nesting console errors appeared after opening the notifications bell (button-in-button from a notification card menu; p-in-p from a scroll area).
frictions.resolution: Recorded in console-errors.txt; absent on clean reloads of the waitlist/floor/today/settings screens, so they are App-shell related and not waitlist-specific.

frictions.description: The location waitlist settings version advanced by 3 (35 -> 38) without any write from this session, so other validators change the same settings concurrently.
frictions.resolution: Re-read the live settings before each write and always sent the live expectedVersion; no 409s occurred. Final state restored and verified.

frictions.resolution: Kept isolation through the owned phone block +155555523x and emails rsv-b3-4..6@example.com and recorded the deviation.
